名词性物主代词 复数 （作主语、表语、宾语）
rows: This is her car. My coat is green. It is my address.
The car is her car. → The car is hers. The address is my address → The address is mine.
These are their names. This is our address in Beijing. This is your air ticket to London.
These names are theirs. This address in Beijing is ours. Yours is to London, too.
These are their keys to the car . 这是他们的车钥匙 These keys to the car are their s . 这些车钥匙是他们的。 It is his phone number. The phone number is his.
These keys to the car belong to them. 这些车钥匙属于他们。 The phone number belongs to him.
The address is not mine. The address not belongs to me . The address doesn’t belong to me.
Are these letters yours? Are these your letters? Are these letters belong to you? Do these letters belong to you?
